production_notes: Production icons contain artwork only; spell names and costs are not baked into them.
Painted subjects occupy 90.6% of the canvas on their longest dimension, within the approved 88–92% range.
Battle-rack intent is approximately 60–68 px; every silhouette is also inspected at 40 px.
The shared pool preserves the payment palette of each spell rather than using one discipline palette.
The gold treatment is a special Aurel-payment palette and is not added to the six element ids.
Corrosive Flask is paid in ice and is identified by a clear snowflake-shaped breach.
Blood-priced spells retain a restrained crimson cost cue within the shadow palette.
Lighting is consistently motivated from the upper-left.

assets.role: Shared-pool spell icon for Base Metal; paid in gold. Blank battered Aurels melt into a vial, spending currency to brew a random vial.
Shared-pool spell icon for Bloom; paid in nature. One seed source produces doubled growth, recalling doubled mana from Resonates.
Shared-pool spell icon for Charnel Pact; paid in shadow. A living hand and skeletal hand seal a blood-priced exchange for Shadow.
Shared-pool spell icon for Corrosive Flask; paid in ice. An ice-paid caustic flask eats a snowflake-shaped breach through a ward shield.
Shared-pool spell icon for Corruption; paid in shadow. Shadow rot consumes one blank ward shield, reducing a chosen Resistance to nothing.
Shared-pool spell icon for Malediction; paid in shadow. One forked curse hook infects two blank result stones, making both outcomes lay Curse.
Shared-pool spell icon for Regrowth; paid in nature. Healthy new growth tears out of dead wood to restore health.
Shared-pool spell icon for Second Death; paid in shadow. A returning blood ribbon loops into a slain skull, repaying health spent if the blow finishes the creature.
